content.title: Sam Altman
content.text: Menu Main menu TED TED Speaker TED Attendee TED Speaker TED Attendee TED Speaker Personal profile Why you should listen Sam Altman is the CEO of OpenAI, developer of influential AI models like ChatGPT, DALL·E, Sora and o1. OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that all of humanity benefits from artificial general intelligence, or AGI — which they define as “highly autonomous systems that outperform humans at most economically valuable work.” Before his time at OpenAI, Altman was president of the startup accelerator Y Combinator.
